analysis.title: Embraer (EMBJ): 3Q26 First Take: Solid quarter; 2026 revenue & FCF guidance raised
key_insights: Embraer 3Q26 revenue of $2.35bn is 7% above FactSet consensus and up 17% yoy, with growth across all segments.
Adjusted EBITDA of $317mn is above consensus of $285mn. EBITDA margin of 13.5% is 100bps ahead of GS's estimate.
Adjusted free cash flow excluding Eve was $628mn against consensus of $178mn.
Segment revenue growth yoy: Commercial +13%, Executive +12%, Defense +22%, Services +30%.
Adjusted EBIT margin by segment: Defense 15.7%, Executive 16.0%, Commercial 2.4%.
Embraer delivered 66 jets in the quarter: 22 commercial (+2 yoy), 41 executive (flat yoy) and 3 defense aircraft.
Backlog is up 14% yoy and up 3% sequentially.
2026 guidance: revenue raised to $8.4-$8.6bn from $8.2-$8.5bn (consensus $8.6bn). Adjusted free cash flow raised to >$700mn from >$400mn (consensus $452mn).
Delivery guidance (80-85 commercial, 160-170 executive) and adjusted EBIT margin guidance (10.0-10.6%, consensus 10.2%) were reiterated.
Adjusted EPS of $0.41 was below GS's estimate of $0.83, driven by interest and debt expense of $159.0mn against a GS estimate of $22.9mn.
GS keeps a Buy rating and a $90 12-month price target, a sum of the parts that implies a 2027 EV/EBITDA of 13.7X plus the Eve stake. The stock closed at $77.07 on 9 Nov 2026, implying 16.8% upside.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 revenue, EBITDA and free cash flow beat consensus, and 2026 revenue and free cash flow guidance were raised. The price target implies 16.8% upside from $77.07.

earnings_insights: EMBJ 3Q26 reported 11/10: revenue $2.35bn vs GS est $2.15bn (+9.2% variance) and vs FactSet consensus (+7%), up 17.2% yoy.
EMBJ 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA $317mn reported vs consensus est $285mn and GS est $269mn. Margin 13.5% vs GS est 12.5%.

EMBJ 3Q26 adjusted EPS $0.41 reported vs GS est $0.83 and 3Q25 $0.46. The miss versus GS is due to interest and debt expense of $159.0mn vs GS est $22.9mn and a 12.3% effective tax rate vs GS est 20.0%.
EMBJ 3Q26 adjusted free cash flow ex-Eve $628mn reported vs consensus est $178mn.
EMBJ 3Q26 gross profit $449.6mn reported vs GS est $474.7mn. Gross margin 19.2% vs GS est 22.1%.

EMBJ 2026 guidance: total revenue $8.4-$8.6bn (prior $8.2-$8.5bn, consensus est $8.6bn). Adjusted EBIT margin 10.0-10.6% reiterated (consensus est 10.2%). Adjusted free cash flow >$700mn (prior >$400mn, consensus est $452mn).
GS estimates EMBJ EPS of $3.47 for 2026E, $3.84 for 2027E and $4.93 for 2028E. Its 9/26E EPS estimate is $0.83 and its 12/26E estimate is $1.27.
